verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis. The evidence shows only a REST API reference (custom integration push APIs, framework health/vendor data APIs) and inbound webhooks. It shows no official client SDK in any language, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so there is no published spec to generate clients from. The GitHub compliance-skills repo is a set of agent skills installed via npx, not an SDK for building against Sprinto's platform.
